description: Optimizer-inclusive synchronized-DDP training benchmark on 4x Ascend 910B2. Times zero-grad + forward + squared-loss + backward WITH DistributedDataParallel gradient all-reduce AND the elementwise AdamW optimizer update, all inside the timed region. This closes the paper's explicitly open 'optimizer-inclusive synchronized-DDP measurement' item.

protocol.timed_work: zero_grad + forward + squared loss + backward (with DDP gradient all-reduce) + optimizer.step()
protocol.timing: max-over-ranks mean, barrier + device synchronize around every iteration

key_findings: Dense optimizer-inclusive synchronized train step: 24.59±0.60 ms (AdamW update adds 8.97 ms over the 15.62 ms synchronized step)
MWG-EW optimizer-inclusive synchronized train steps: 5.94-7.29 ms across ranks 32-512 (AdamW update adds only 1.0-1.3 ms)
Optimizer-inclusive synchronized train-step speedup vs dense (world 4): 3.37x-4.14x (r192 highest at 4.14x, r512 lowest at 3.37x)

The paper's assumption that the optimizer update 'cancels across arms' is empirically wrong in MWG-EW's favor: dense pays 9.0 ms for its 3dm-parameter AdamW update vs 1.0-1.3 ms for MWG-EW's r(d+m) parameters

This closes the last explicitly-open systems measurement: every component of a real distributed training step (zero-grad, forward, loss, DDP-synchronized backward, optimizer update) is now timed on ASI2 at 8B-scale geometry
